monograph.title: The Refractive Spires: The Architecture of Optical Stratigraphy
monograph.core_thesis: Coherent photon fluxes refracted through non-Euclidean lattices crystallize into load-bearing dielectric structural struts.
axioms: Luminosity functions as a rigid tensor field under precise geometric constraint.
Crossed optical beams bind zero-point vacuum energy into transparent structural barriers.
Refraction matrices are permanently archived as stratigraphic layers within the Ash Archive.
